value_plan.instructions: With four workers, which plan does the campaign follow from here? Deferred items go to the open-work list, not into the queue.

criteria.daily_parity_core: Finish the six in flight, trimming J08 round 2 to its re-open fix (drop the edge-strip rework). Then only: J17 Alt+Tab, J20 Control Center, J21 Notification Center, J23 Search, J33 icon plate (stage B, then the mask), J40 translations, in that order. Defer the rest. Strongest case: the features every user touches every day, the visible identity, and Khmer reach, with the least spent.
criteria.polish_first: Finish the six in flight, then the icon set J33-J35, J22 bar order, J25 session menu, J26 Settings search, J27 Launchpad folder, J40. Defer Phase 2 features. Strongest case: smaller jobs with no J07 dependency, quick visible wins. Cost: the biggest daily gaps against macOS (Alt+Tab, Control Center, Notification Center, Search) stay open.
criteria.finish_then_deploy: Finish the six in flight (J08 trimmed), add J40, then stop new work and ask the founder to deploy and use the desktop; pick the next items from real use. Strongest case: nothing merged has been seen on a real seat yet, and real use is the best value signal. Cost: Phase 2 parity features wait on the founder's deploy and feedback.
